title: Double honors to Bishop Kani—Austin’s own, leading our people from the forefront.
cleanTitle: Double honors to Bishop Kani—Austin’s own, leading our people from the forefront.
segments: As you may have learned about the
general  Bishop Nathaniel,
here's some history on IUIC's Bishop
Canaan I. Born in the 1960s of New York
City, Bishop Canaan I had a profound
awakening when he realized that the
Bible was not just a spiritual text, but
a record of our history. The deeper he
delved, the more he recognized that what
he had once seen as distant
narratives were, in fact, reflections of
our own ancestral journey. The
revelation that slavery was not just a
tragic  chapter in modern
history, but deeply intertwined with
biblical history stirred something
within him. That realization ignited a
passion to seek truth, reclaim identity,
and embrace a deeper
understanding of who his people are and
where we come from.
